Hi Rich,
I am emailing regarding a voluntary offer for Southern Financial. GE is offering its shareholders the opportunity to
exchange shares of GE for shares of Symphony Financial. Recall that Southern Financial holds 23,000 shares of GE valued
at -$685,000. Southern Financial can swap all, some or none of its shares for Symphony.
Please refer to the attached prospectus and below website for further information.

As per the below details, we require Southern Financial to make a decision by 11/13/15. Let us know if you have any
questions.
Have a great weekend,
